plan.1_where_sign_application_happens: Its own guarded job, before Q01 plausibility, not part of R01 (R01 only bundles reviewed columns; it must not run numerics). Recommended new task UM21-T04 'Apply CORE-11 full-mode signs to the T03 treadmill outputs' (depends on UM21-T03, CORE-11-P-UM21, UM21-E01; Q01 and R01 then depend on it). Not added to the backlog here (minimal edits); coordinator decides. Design: a new thin runner and adapter step that, for each of the 44 T03 records, re-reads the untransformed Streaming.mat channels one recording at a time, calls run_sign_application(mode='full', pilot_record_path=v4 record) with unit IDs equal to the T03 observation IDs, then derives segments and velocities after the hook, and writes rule-B columns plus sign_application.json and sign_review.json to a NEW output root (never overwriting T03). Open mapping risk: T03 observations may not equal the adapter's heel-strike pairs (curated windows). Step 0 is a read-only probe on one record (observation_id/source_start/end only, under 100 MiB) to measure the match. If the adapter or any bound file must change, the v4 pilot is invalid and a v5 re-pilot (7 records, about 8 s, 160 MiB) is needed first. Preferred: put the observation mapping in the new runner, outside the bound set, and verify bindings list before editing anything.
plan.2_profile_ranges: No approved range fits today, so by default every plausibility check is unassessed (state 'unchecked', visible, never pass). The default profile is a tuner draft with no applicability, review or evidence, and is circular for UM21. Plausibility is a separate assessment layer from the structural/time/side/source-fidelity layer (150 inclusive samples, finite, real clock, side and observation lineage). Eligible canonical columns after T04: pelvis tilt, hip and knee angle, and hip/knee/ankle flexion moments (rule B, audited signs). Never passing: ankle angle (zero offset unreviewed, anomalous recording-sides missing), thigh/shank (planar approximations), velocities, powers, joint forces, GRF/CoP (source-only, N and mm), frontal/transverse. A profile for Q01 would be a new reviewed file with population (able-bodied adults), task (level/incline/decline treadmill), units, canonical applicability and evidence per feature, plus a review record. That approval is a scientific choice: see the drafted decision below. Until José answers, Q01 can finish the structural layer and the plausibility layer as all-unchecked.
plan.3_jobs_and_memory: All launcher jobs: one worker, thread env 1, nice 19 / ionice idle, address space 768 MiB (never raised), serial, dry run first, a pilot before the full run of the same bound code, one record at a time. J0 read-only probe (no launcher, AGENTS.md exception): one record, id/start/end columns only, estimate 60-100 MiB peak RSS, record it. J1 T04 pilot: 1 record (AB04/i0, the pelvis-correction case), then 7 seeded records, estimate 150-200 MiB (v4 pilot: 160 MiB on 7 records). J2 T04 full: 44 records in 4 serial batches of 11 as in T03, one record resident at a time, estimate under 250 MiB (T03 largest 245 MiB, readback 183 MiB). J3 Q01 structural + plausibility assessment: reads only needed columns per record (about 30 of 114 columns, 24,000 rows, under 10 MiB of arrays), via assess_observations, one record per pass, estimate under 150 MiB, below the 256 MiB admission estimate; writes one JSON assessment plus a per-observation table under a new root; pilot on one record then 44. Nothing runs until J0, then J1, pass. MATLAB not needed.

drafted_decision_not_in_backlog.note: Draft only. Per AGENTS.md copy into backlog.json from a verified handoff.
drafted_decision_not_in_backlog.question: No reviewed range exists for able-bodied treadmill walking in this dataset. What should the first treadmill release check for plausibility?
drafted_decision_not_in_backlog.options_order: By amount of plausibility checking: none, gross limits, population ranges.

options.label: Nothing beyond structure; plausibility left unassessed
options.consequence: Every plausibility result shows as not checked and nothing is removed for being implausible; no approval needed. Reversible.

options.label: Gross physical limits only (blatant errors)
options.consequence: Flags only impossible values (angle beyond a full turn, moment beyond a stated bound), each with a written source; keeps source values otherwise. One reviewed profile to write. Reversible.

options.label: Able-bodied walking ranges per task
options.consequence: Excludes strides outside published level, incline and decline bands. Needs cited population evidence for each column; the current ranges came from this dataset, so they cannot be used as is. Slowest, and can remove real variation. Reversible.

drafted_decision_not_in_backlog.cost_of_waiting: Structural assessment and the sign step proceed; the release shows all plausibility as not checked until answered.
drafted_decision_not_in_backlog.why: Matches the standing rule to fix only blatant errors; avoids tuning to this dataset's own distribution.

t04_runner.ruling: Coordinator: apply hook multipliers to all 7,562 only if the bound API can apply a settled multiplier to given arrays; else option (a).
t04_runner.api_finding: The bound sign_application module has no function that applies a settled multiplier or verdict to other arrays. run_sign_application re-runs the detector on whatever it is given; undo_sign_application refuses arrays whose hashes differ from the log. Applying a multiplier to the 15 extra observations would reimplement the arithmetic, so fallback option (a) is used. The 15 are listed as unmapped and unassessed.
t04_runner.design: Outside the bound set; bound in the spec. Adapter and hook run unchanged (adapter convert_recording, pilot-style group checks/writes imported from run_core11_um21_pilot by file). A T03 observation is signed only if its id equals a hook unit id exactly; per-observation evidence log gives hook units and the leg-level multipliers. Held channels never written. Output is a new root; T03 phase files are sha256-checked against the T03 receipts and read two columns only. Full mode is not enabled in the CLI (a ModeProxy that hands the committed v4 pilot record path to the bound hook is written and tested but unused); full mode needs its own review.
